newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Pasminco says found gold in Benagerie.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Pasminco says found gold in Benagerie.

text.p: Pasminco Ltd said on Friday exploration drilling on the Benagerie prospect in South Australia has intersected anomalous gold mineralisation.
It said 22 shallow drill holes were subsequently drilled and 21 out of 22 holes intersected further anomalous gold mineralisation at a depth of 70 to 100 metres.
Additional drilling required to assess the economic signifigance of these rsults, Pasminco said.
Pasminco holds a 70 percent interest in the Benagerie license.
Pasminco officials declined comment further on the prospect, However, analysts said the next stage for Pasminco would be to test for an existing orebody and define a grade of ore-to-gold-ratio.
"They have not found an orebody," Will Corkill, a resource analyst for Macquarie Equities Ltd said. "What Pasminco is saying is that they may have found an orebody."
Corkill said the depth of mineralisation was encouraging, although more work was needed to identify a resource.
Pasminco's main interests are in mining and smelting of base metals, mainly lead and zinc.
"There is no one who is going to say that now Pasminco is a lead, zinc and gold company," he said.
The Financial Review newspaper reported on Friday that the Benagerie prospect could contain at least 200,000 ounces.
However, analysts said it was probably too early to estimate the level of gold contained in the prospect.
Pasminco shares were trading one cent higher at A$1.85 at 11.20 a.m. (0120 GMT).
